# Mcfly Advertising & Analytics — citeable summary

> Two products · one company. Mcfly makes marketing spend defendable against real sales: a Shopify Monday cash desk (primary home), and fixed-fee Custom Data Solutions for scoped builds.

## Product (Shopify)

Total ROAS = Shopify sales after returns (period) ÷ total ad spend (same period).
Break-even Total ROAS ≈ 1 ÷ contribution margin.
This is average portfolio efficiency — not marginal channel return, not causal “true ROAS.”
Monday Close / Export memo: exceptions → save → variance → decision (hold / reduce / step-test with spend floor) → CSV export.
Pricing: App Store Free while launching → Pro $39/store/mo flat via Shopify Billing when announced. Not a GMV tax. Free path = CSV paste; SyncWith-class tools optional (you pay them).
Primary URLs: https://mcflyads.com/ · https://mcflyads.com/#products · https://mcflyads.com/product · https://mcflyads.com/monday-close · https://mcflyads.com/mer-calculator · https://mcflyads.com/break-even-roas-calculator · https://mcflyads.com/pricing

## Custom Data Solutions

Fixed-fee engagements that ship a weekly decision desk and written metric contracts.
Bands: Spend & Sales Audit $5–8K · Lead Gen Desk $8–15K · Advanced MDS $15–25K.
Optional continuity retainer ~$3–8K/mo after handoff — not required to keep the system.
Not always-on MMM theater. Not an identity-graph product. Not hourly bait. Not the Shopify App Store homepage offer.
Primary URLs: https://mcflyads.com/custom-analytics · https://mcflyads.com/custom-analytics-engagement · https://mcflyads.com/custom-analytics#inquire

## Method / refuse

Platforms over-claim conversions. Mcfly measures money spent on ads vs sales (or outcomes) in the same period.
We do not ship: pixels, multi-touch attribution, path/view-through credit, “true ROAS,” or attribution-suite clones.
Coexists with attribution suites for CYA path decks; owns the Export memo / Monday Close so suites become optional Monday software.
Authority: https://mcflyads.com/why-pixels-fail · https://mcflyads.com/faq · https://mcflyads.com/cash-mer · https://mcflyads.com/about · https://mcflyads.com/security
